review: Ground material review uses the authoritative approved-game-reference.jpg and the supplemental town-master-scene.png, compared directly with the published chapel screenshot. Paving now uses the 883-square inner left panel of lighting/ground-materials.png: pale warm-neutral limestone, flatter squarer worn faces and restrained shallow earth/moss joints, replacing the darker rounded granular cobbles. The full unmodified generated sheet and exact prompt/input hashes are preserved in ground_light_generation.json. The right grass panel was rejected because its wiry moss texture did not improve the reference; existing short-grass/clover grass-v2.png and earthy paths remain. Each tile is opaque and authored orthographic top-down with a uniform neutral diffuse base, no baked canopy cast shadow, sun patch or isometric perspective; runtime supplies the ground camera and scene lighting. Paving rows remain more regular than the reference, so source adoption requires actual-scale scene comparison rather than claiming final mood completion. Existing flora remains unchanged: high leaf surfaces, occluded rear stems, root contacts, alpha0 surroundings and clean light/dark composites were previously reviewed; organic clumps do not receive invented rigid-edge angles.

flowers_white.review: Ground-contact centre at the converging lower flower stems under the central leaf rosette. Foreground leaves remain beyond the contact; this is not the lowest petal or silhouette pixel.

flowers_warm.review: Shared rooted centre beneath the warm flower stems and grass rosettes. The thin forward blades retain depth below the anchor.

fern.review: Ground contact under the fern petiole crown and overlapping low leaves. Rear stems and forward fronds retain their natural occlusion and spread.

grass.review: Contact under the dense central grass bases and low leaf rosettes. Tall blades do not determine the anchor, and foreground leaves remain visible below it.
